sloka: आरामैश्च विहारैश्च शोभमानं समन्ततः ।शोभितां शोभनीयैश्च तथा ऽन्यैर्दैवमानुषैः ।। ७.७०.१३ ॥
transliteration: ārāmaiśca vihāraiśca śobhamānaṁ samantataḥ ।śobhitāṁ śobhanīyaiśca tathā 'nyairdaivamānuṣaiḥ ।। 7.70.13 ॥

translations.english: The city was adorned all around with gardens and pleasure-grounds, and beautified by other divine and human elements.
